scope: P02 phone-only and remote PNG evidence after Round 9 HUD/chart corrections

reviewMethod.latest: SHA256 comparison of every current PNG against the prior individually accounted manual review set
reviewMethod.prior: All 112 full frames reviewed in 28 native-size four-frame sheets; six hardest frames also reviewed individually; independent second review of five hard frames
reviewMethod.rationale: No assigned current PNG differs from its previously reviewed counterpart.

observedFindings: No confirmed clipping, lost legal text, misleading room-personal correctness, incorrect tie cue, TV-only phone instructions, broken Left/Away label, or hidden final-result disclosure in the assigned frames.
The 110-character prompts, 42-character choices, 120-character explanations and 40-character player names remain visible.
Group chart, explanation and standings are separate readable panes.
Team receipts distinguish personal points from shared averaged gain; Room receipts distinguish the private vote from the shared chosen answer.
Opened own-team rosters preserve the clock and provide a visible return to question.

remainingWeaknesses.weakness: Static captures do not establish coordinated live eight-person comprehension, network recovery, delivered audio or animation timing.

Pathological many-word legal custom content leads to large visible reading windows (141-second question; 75–78-second talk in the reviewed wordy fixtures). The required reading floor is functioning; shorter, meaningful authored content would improve party pace.
remainingWeaknesses.action: Prefer concise authored custom questions; do not shorten the required reading floor.

remainingWeaknesses.weakness: Crossed-out 42-character unbroken wrong choices remain visually dense, despite fitting fully. This is confined to pathological content in these frames.
The compact result receipt sits far below the chart, so newcomers must shift attention to notice personal and shared gains. Labels remain readable and distinct.
The shared Room podium retains empty second/third-place tiers. It adds a little competitive framing to a cooperative score, without presenting incorrect winners or leaking hidden identities.

eightStrangerReview.conclusion: No actionable runtime defect or necessary source change is supported by this review. This is not a claim of live eight-person or original-audio convergence.

limitations: The assigned PNG review scope uses English at 390×844; it does not establish fit under OS text zoom or additional device viewports.
No tests, browser, git or runtime mutation performed by this reviewer.
The 179 measured scroller containers all report zero overflow; container presence is not a scroll failure.

capture.nativeDisclosureMethod: pointer press/release opens; focused Enter down/up closes

finalFormattingReproducibility.reason: Every final PNG is SHA256-identical to its already reviewed Round 10 counterpart.
